note: The formula of a hydrate (GAME_SPEC §13, the balance and Readings; §13.7; Stage 50; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 6): an analytical balance, an empty 50 mL beaker for a dish, a jar of blue copper sulfate crystals, a burner. Read by instruments: the balance tells what was taken, and the water the crystals give up when heated is their mass lost. CuSO4.5H2O is 36.1 % water by mass.
